$comment: Docs metadata. Feeds the docs site (sidebar, pages, search) and the registry item descriptions. Every registry:ui item needs an entry and a demo in components/demos/<name>.tsx.

button.title: Button
button.description: Actions with press feedback, a smooth loading state and an optional hotkey.
notes: `loading` keeps the label, slides a spinner in and blocks clicks while keeping focus.
`hotkey="Mod+S"` presses the button from anywhere; `showHotkey` renders the key caps.
Icon-only buttons need an `aria-label`; the hit area grows to 44px on touch screens.

input.title: Input
input.description: Single-line text field sized by the control tokens.
notes: 16px text on touch screens so iOS never zooms on focus.
`clearable` adds an X while there's a value; it fires `onChange` like typing, then `onClear`.
`type="file"` shows the picked file's name instead of the browser's "Choose File" button, with an X to unselect.
Pair with `Field` or `FormField` for label, description and error.

input-group.title: Input Group
input-group.description: An input with leading or trailing addons: icons, text, buttons.
notes: Addons align with `inline-start`, `inline-end`, `block-start` or `block-end`.
Clicking an addon focuses the input.

textarea.title: Textarea
textarea.description: Multi-line text that grows with its content.
notes: Grows with `field-sizing: content`; cap it with `max-h-*`.

select.title: Select
select.description: Pick one option from a list. The popup lines its selected item up with the trigger.
notes: On touch screens, a select with `items` renders the native picker.
The chevron flips while the popup is open.
Type to jump to an option; Home and End go to the ends.

native-select.title: Native Select
native-select.description: The platform select, styled like the rest of the controls.
notes: Best on mobile and for long, plain lists.

combobox.title: Combobox
combobox.description: Type to filter a list and pick one value.
notes: Use it once a list has 8 or more options.
Arrow keys move, Enter picks, Escape closes.
Past a few hundred options, set `virtualized` on `Combobox` and render rows with `ComboboxVirtualList`.

multi-select.title: Multi Select
multi-select.description: Pick several values as removable tags, with type-to-filter.
notes: Backspace in the empty input removes the last tag.
Values are plain strings; labels come from `options`.
The list is virtualized: thousands of options open and filter instantly.

checkbox.title: Checkbox
checkbox.description: On, off or mixed. The whole label toggles it.
notes: `indeterminate` shows a dash, for a parent of partly selected rows.
The hit area extends past the box, so small checkboxes stay easy to tap.

switch.title: Switch
switch.description: A setting that applies immediately when toggled.
notes: Use a checkbox instead when the change waits for a Save button.

label.title: Label
label.description: Names a control. Clicking it focuses or toggles the control.

field.title: Field
field.description: Label, control, description and error laid out together, vertically or horizontally.
notes: `orientation="horizontal"` puts checkboxes and switches beside their label.
`FieldSet` and `FieldLegend` group related fields.

form.title: Form
form.description: react-hook-form and zod wired to fields: validation on blur, then live; a banner for server errors.
notes: `useZodForm(schema)` validates on blur, then on every change.
Errors thrown from `onSubmit` become a banner at the top of the form.
Double submits are blocked while a submit is pending; the first invalid field takes focus.

dialog.title: Dialog
dialog.description: A modal window. Becomes a bottom drawer on phones.
notes: Below 640px it renders as a drawer you can swipe down; opt out with `responsive={false}`.
Focus is trapped inside and returns to the trigger on close.

alert-dialog.title: Alert Dialog
alert-dialog.description: Asks for confirmation before a destructive action.
notes: Prefer undo over confirmation for reversible actions (see Toast).
Clicking outside doesn't dismiss it.

drawer.title: Drawer
drawer.description: A panel that slides in from an edge and follows your finger.
notes: Swipe in its direction to dismiss; the backdrop fades with the drag.

sheet.title: Sheet
sheet.description: A side panel for filters, details and navigation.
notes: `side` can be `top`, `right`, `bottom` or `left`.

popover.title: Popover
popover.description: Rich content anchored to a trigger. A bottom sheet on phones.
notes: Scales in from its trigger; Escape or a click outside closes it.

dropdown-menu.title: Dropdown Menu
dropdown-menu.description: A list of actions, with hotkeys, checkboxes, radios and submenus.
notes: Items accept a `hotkey` that works while the menu is closed.
A bottom sheet on phones.

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.description: A short label for an icon or a hint, with an optional hotkey.
notes: Opens after 400ms; moving between tooltips is instant.
Never put essential information only in a tooltip: touch screens can't hover.

command.title: Command
command.description: A searchable list of commands, inline or as a Mod+K palette.
notes: Arrow keys move, Enter runs, Escape closes the dialog.

alert.title: Alert
alert.description: An inline message, as a bordered card or a tinted callout.
notes: `tone` makes a borderless tinted callout; an `AlertAction` sits on the trailing edge.

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: Status pills and counts in seven contrast-checked tones.
notes: `tone` replaces the variant's colors with a tint of the tone.

sonner.title: Toast
sonner.description: Transient notifications, including undo for reversible actions.
notes: Toasts stay 6s and pause on hover, focus or a hidden tab.
`toastUndo(message, { onUndo })` runs the action now and offers to revert it for 10s.

skeleton.title: Skeleton
skeleton.description: Placeholders shaped like the content that is loading.
notes: `SkeletonGroup` announces the loading state once and appears after 200ms, so fast responses never flash.

spinner.title: Spinner
notes: Prefer a skeleton for content and `Button loading` for actions.

empty.title: Empty
empty.description: What a region shows when there is nothing in it yet, and how to fill it.

error-state.title: Error State
error-state.description: A region that failed to load: what failed, a retry, and a request ID for support.
notes: Render it per section, so the rest of the screen stays usable.

card.title: Card
card.description: A surface with a header, content and footer.
notes: `size="sm"` tightens the spacing.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: A tinted tray holding white cards with concentric corners.
notes: Card radii follow `--ds-panel-radius` minus `--ds-panel-pad`, so corners stay parallel.

item.title: Item
item.description: A row with media, title, description and actions.
notes: Render it as a link or button with `render` to make the whole row clickable.

data-list.title: Data List
data-list.description: Label and value pairs that reflow with their container.
notes: `layout="row"` spreads short pairs across a line; `stack` lists them.

icon-tile.title: Icon Tile
icon-tile.description: An icon on a tinted square: the leading visual of rows, dialogs and results.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: A user's picture with initials as fallback, alone or stacked.

hotkey.title: Hotkey
hotkey.description: Shows a shortcut for the user's platform: Mod+K reads ⌘K on macOS and Ctrl K elsewhere.
notes: Hidden on touch screens, where there is no keyboard.

table.title: Table
table.description: Semantic table parts. For sorting, filters and pages use the Data Table block.

accordion.title: Accordion
accordion.description: Stacked sections that expand one or several at a time.
notes: The panel height animates; reduced motion keeps only a fade.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.description: Switch between views, as pills, a line or a sliding segmented control.
notes: Arrow keys move between tabs.

sortable.title: Sortable
sortable.description: A list you reorder by dragging, or with the keyboard.
notes: Keyboard: focus a handle, Space to lift, arrows to move, Space to drop, Escape to cancel.
Moves are announced to screen readers; works inside dialogs.

radio-group.title: Radio Group
radio-group.description: Pick exactly one of a few visible options.
notes: Use it for 2 to 5 options that should all stay visible; past that, a Select.
Arrow keys move the selection within the group.

toggle.title: Toggle
toggle.description: A button that stays pressed: bold on, bold off.
notes: `pressed` / `onPressedChange`; the pressed state is announced to screen readers.

toggle-group.title: Toggle Group
toggle-group.description: A row of toggles, single or multiple choice: alignment, view modes, filters.
notes: `spacing={0}` joins the items into one segmented control.
Arrow keys move focus between items.

slider.title: Slider
slider.description: Pick a value or a range by dragging.
notes: Arrow keys step, Shift+arrows step by 10, Home and End jump to the ends.
Pass an array for a range; the thumb grows slightly while dragged.

input-otp.title: Input OTP
input-otp.description: One-time codes for 2FA and email verification.
notes: Pasting fills every slot; `autoComplete="one-time-code"` lets phones offer the SMS code.
`onComplete` fires on the last digit, so you can verify without a submit button.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: A month grid for picking a day or a range (react-day-picker).
notes: Arrow keys move by day, Page Up/Down by month.
Cells grow to 40px on touch screens, shrinking to fit a 320px sheet.
Month and year pickers (`captionLayout="dropdown"`) are our Select, not the browser's.

date-picker.title: Date Picker
date-picker.description: A form field that opens a calendar, for a single date or a range.
notes: Looks and behaves like a Select; `clearable` adds a clear button for optional dates.
A bottom sheet on phones; the range picker shows one month there and two elsewhere.
Ranges: the first click starts, the second ends and closes.
Forms: `name` submits ISO dates; `onBlur` fires when the calendar closes, so validation waits until then.
`captionLayout="dropdown"` with `startMonth`/`endMonth` for far dates (birthdays).
Labels use date-fns patterns (`dateFormat`).

file-dropzone.title: File Dropzone
file-dropzone.description: Drop files or browse, with type and size limits and a removable list.
notes: The zone is one button: Enter or Space opens the file picker.
Rejected files are listed with the reason (type, size, count) instead of disappearing.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: How far along a task is.
notes: For a value against a limit (seats, storage) use a meter instead; see the Billing block.

breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.description: Where this page sits in the hierarchy, with links back up.
notes: The current page is `aria-current="page"` and not a link.

pagination.title: Pagination
notes: `getPageRange(page, pageCount)` returns the pages and ellipses to render, always the same count, so the row never changes width.

chart.title: Chart
chart.description: Recharts with a validated categorical palette, DS tooltips and legends.
notes: Series colors are `--ds-chart-1` to `-8` (`fill-series-1`…): the same hues in every theme, validated for color blindness in light and dark. Assign them in order, never cycled.
Two or more series always get a legend; every chart gets a tooltip.
One y-axis per chart: two measures of different scale go in two charts.

theme-toggle.title: Theme Toggle
theme-toggle.description: Light and dark in one button, or system / light / dark as a segmented switch.
notes: Built on next-themes (`ThemeProvider attribute="class"`).
The toggle picks its icon with CSS, so there is no flash or hydration mismatch; with a `hotkey` it switches instantly.

language-select.title: Language Select
language-select.description: Pick the interface language, each name in its own language and script.
notes: Options carry `lang`, so screen readers pronounce each name correctly.
`compact` shows an icon and the code (EN) for headers and footers.

password-input.title: Password Input
password-input.description: A password field with a show/hide toggle and a Caps Lock warning.
notes: Showing the password keeps focus and the caret in place.
Use `autoComplete="new-password"` on sign-up so password managers suggest one.

token-input.title: Token Input
token-input.description: Free-form values as removable tokens: emails, keywords, domains.
notes: Enter, comma or Tab adds; pasting a list adds each entry; blur keeps a half-typed one.
Invalid tokens stay, marked with the reason, so nothing typed is lost.
For values from a fixed list, use Multi Select.

time-input.title: Time Input
time-input.description: A time of day with the browser's own segmented field and native picker on touch.
notes: `step` is in seconds: 900 snaps the arrows to 15 minutes; under 60 adds seconds.
Pair it with Date Picker for a date and time.

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: A star rating: a radio group when interactive, an image with fractions when read-only.
notes: Hover previews; arrow keys move and pick.
`readOnly` is named "4.5 out of 5 stars" for review summaries.

tree.title: Tree
tree.description: A virtualized file-explorer tree with keyboard navigation, selection and filtering.
notes: Only rows in view render: tens of thousands of nodes stay fast.
Arrows move and open, Home/End jump, Enter selects, * opens siblings, typing jumps to a label.
`filter` shows matches with their ancestors; debounce it with `useDebouncedState`.

virtual-list.title: Virtual List
virtual-list.description: A scrolling list that renders only the items in view, for feeds and logs.
notes: Use it for any list that can grow past ~100 items.
Items may differ in height; each is measured once rendered.
`onEndReached` loads the next page; guard requests already in flight.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: A vertical history of events with tone markers: audit logs, order status, deploys.
notes: Give `TimelineTime` an ISO `dateTime`.
Past ~50 events, show the latest with a "Show more", or render them in a Virtual List.

resizable.title: Resizable
resizable.description: Panels split by draggable, keyboard-operable handles.
notes: Handles take drag, arrows, Home/End and double-click to reset.
Persist sizes with `onLayoutChanged` and `defaultLayout`.
App sidebars use the app shell pattern instead.

settings-list.title: Settings List
settings-list.description: One row per setting: title and description beside the control, hairline dividers, stacked when narrow.
notes: Use it for long pages of individual settings; keep cards for grouped forms (profile, members).
`htmlFor` labels a single control; groups take `aria-labelledby={labelId}`.
With React Hook Form: `<FormField layout="row">`.

swatch-picker.title: Swatch Picker
swatch-picker.description: Pick one color from a row of swatches: accent colors, labels, themes.
notes: A radio group: arrows move and pick.
The chosen swatch gets a ring in its own color and a check, so it never relies on color alone.
Pass token colors (`var(--ds-tone-blue)`).

timezone-select.title: Timezone Select
timezone-select.description: Search every IANA time zone by city, region or offset; virtualized.
notes: Offsets follow today's date (DST) and appear after mount, so server and client render the same.
Values are IANA ids ("America/Sao_Paulo").

unsaved-changes-bar.title: Unsaved Changes Bar
unsaved-changes-bar.description: A floating Discard / Save bar that rises in once a form has edits.
notes: Place it last inside the `<form>`; Save submits it and answers Mod+S.
Leaving the page while it is open asks first.
Use it for pages that save as a whole; settings that apply at once (theme) skip it.

blocks.title: Landing page
blocks.description: Marketing header (sheet on mobile, theme and language), hero with a framed product preview, logo cloud, feature grid and testimonials.

blocks.title: Pricing page
blocks.description: Monthly/yearly plans with the saving inline, a comparison table that becomes a plan picker on phones, FAQ and a closing call to action.

blocks.title: Dashboard
blocks.description: KPI tiles with sparklines, revenue and signup charts, activity and top projects; the range lives in the URL.

blocks.title: App shell
blocks.description: Resizable sidebar (drag the edge; under 160px it settles to icons) with ease-out, cascade or scrub label motion, nested groups, Mod+K palette, G-then-key navigation, a sheet on mobile.

blocks.title: Grouped table
blocks.description: Rows in collapsible groups with pinned header, group bands and a calculation footer; continuous row numbers, group selection and a floating bulk-action bar.

blocks.title: Infinite table
blocks.description: Cursor pagination that loads ahead as you scroll: skeleton rows, inline retry, an end marker, a Load more fallback and back to top.

blocks.title: Notifications
blocks.description: A bell menu with unread count (Shift+N) and a full feed with mark as read and archive with undo.

blocks.title: Setup wizard
blocks.description: Workspace, team and plan in steps: the step in the URL, validation per step, values kept going back, direction-aware transitions.

blocks.title: Get started checklist
blocks.description: Segmented progress and tasks; the next open one expands with its action. Shown on the dashboard.

blocks.title: First-run intro
blocks.description: A product area's empty page as an invitation: two-line title, pill actions, art bleeding off the corner, a hint.

blocks.title: First-run card
blocks.description: The compact empty state for a list: what goes here, two actions, media tiles.

blocks.title: Data table
blocks.description: Search, filters, sort and pages kept in the URL, bulk actions and every loading state.

blocks.title: Settings
blocks.description: Profile form, members and roles, and a delete confirmed by typing the name.

blocks.title: General settings
blocks.description: Workspace preferences as a flat settings list: name, URL, week start, allowed domains, accent color, language and time zone, date format, composer switches and theme. Edits raise an unsaved-changes bar (Discard, Save, Mod+S).

blocks.title: Pricing and billing
blocks.description: Monthly or yearly plans, usage meters and invoices.

blocks.title: Sign in
blocks.description: Google and SSO, email and password, and a banner for server errors.

blocks.title: Sign up
blocks.description: Live password rules and terms.

blocks.title: Sign up, image right
blocks.description: Split layout with the media on the trailing side.

blocks.title: Sign up, image left
blocks.description: Split layout with the media on the leading side.

blocks.title: Reset password
blocks.description: Ends on a check-your-inbox state.

blocks.title: Site footer
blocks.description: Brand, link columns, newsletter, then copyright, status, language and theme. Reflows with its container.

blocks.title: Not found
blocks.description: 404, 403, 500 and maintenance pages with the way out.

blocks.title: Server error
blocks.description: Retry and a request ID for support.
